request_id.description: The item id: the network replays the same answer for the same request_id for 7 days.

email.description: The customer's address; normalised by the network (§2).

email_proof.description: How this business proved the address: its one-time code, or authenticated mail (ADR-017 A1.7).

key_email.description: network: the network emails the person's key itself, in the business's name, and sends none in its answer, so the business never holds it. Absent, or sent to a network that does not know it: the answer carries the key, for the business to email.
